odc_type: Incorrect varargs argument handling in argument capturing
observation_summary: Argument capturing fails with ArrayIndexOutOfBoundsException or incorrect captured values when using varargs in mocked methods.
reasoning_summary: The bug occurs when Mockito attempts to capture arguments from a method call involving varargs. The original implementation incorrectly iterated through the matchers and attempted to map them directly to indices in the raw arguments array, leading to ArrayIndexOutOfBoundsExceptions when the number of matchers did not align with the varargs array length, or incorrect captures when multiple matchers were used. The fix introduces a mechanism to correctly identify and iterate over the varargs array elements and map them to the appropriate capturing matchers, ensuring that all vararg elements are processed correctly regardless of the number of matchers.
